# Freshness check report

This file is regenerated by `.github/workflows/freshness-check.yml` (weekly,
Monday 08:00 UTC, or on demand via `workflow_dispatch`), which runs
`scripts/check-freshness.sh`. It has not run in this repo yet -- the first
run replaces this placeholder and, if it finds drift, opens a PR with the
regenerated content.

Do not hand-edit: any manual changes here are overwritten on the next run.
